cells.label: Staff
cells.html: Staff

metadata.plantUmlData:
{
  "data": "@startuml
left to right direction

skinparam shadowing false
skinparam defaultFontName Arial
skinparam usecaseFontSize 11
skinparam actorFontSize 12
skinparam ArrowColor #202020

skinparam rectangle {
  BackgroundColor #80CBEF
  BorderColor #202020
  FontColor #202020
}

skinparam usecase {
  BackgroundColor #80CBEF
  BorderColor #202020
  FontColor #202020
}

skinparam actor {
  BackgroundColor #80CBEF
  BorderColor #202020
  FontColor #202020
}

actor "Staff" as Staff

rectangle "SMARTOMNI PLATFORM" {
  ' ===== RETURNS =====
  usecase "View return requests" as returnView
  usecase "Process returned goods" as returnProcess
  usecase "Record receipt of returned goods" as returnReceive
  usecase "Upload inspection video" as returnVideo
  usecase "Assess returned goods condition" as returnInspect
  usecase "Restock returned goods appropriately" as returnRestock
  usecase "Add returned goods to sellable stock" as returnSellable
  usecase "Add returned goods to quarantined stock" as returnQuarantine
  usecase "View dispute status" as returnDispute

  ' ===== MARKETPLACE CONVERSATIONS =====
  usecase "View conversations" as inboxView
  usecase "View messages and attachments" as inboxContent
  usecase "View complaint classification" as inboxComplaint
  usecase "Reply to conversation" as inboxReply
  usecase "Send reply through marketplace" as inboxSend
  usecase "View message delivery status" as inboxSendStatus
  usecase "Mark complaint as resolved" as inboxResolve

  ' ===== AI AND BUSINESS ANALYTICS =====
  usecase "Enter sales events" as aiSalesEvent
  usecase "View demand forecasts" as aiForecast
  usecase "View inventory alerts" as aiStockAlert
  usecase "View business dashboard" as biDashboard
  usecase "Enter business costs" as biCostInput
  usecase "View actual profit" as biProfit
  usecase "Ask AI Advisor" as biAskAdvisor
  usecase "View strategic advice" as biAdvice
}

actor "Marketplace\n(Shopee / TikTok Shop)" as Marketplace

Staff -- returnView
Staff -- returnProcess
Staff -- returnDispute
Staff -- inboxView
Staff -- inboxContent
Staff -- inboxComplaint
Staff -- inboxReply
Staff -- inboxSendStatus
Staff -- inboxResolve
Staff -- aiSalesEvent
Staff -- aiForecast
Staff -- aiStockAlert
Staff -- biDashboard
Staff -- biCostInput
Staff -- biProfit
Staff -- biAskAdvisor
Staff -- biAdvice

returnView -- Marketplace
returnDispute -- Marketplace
inboxSend -- Marketplace
biProfit -- Marketplace

returnProcess ..> returnReceive : <<include>>
returnProcess ..> returnVideo : <<include>>
returnProcess ..> returnInspect : <<include>>
returnProcess ..> returnRestock : <<include>>
inboxReply ..> inboxSend : <<include>>

inboxResolve ..> inboxComplaint : <<extend>>\n[complaint handled]

returnRestock <|-- returnSellable
returnRestock <|-- returnQuarantine

@enduml",
  "config": null
}
